body: New internal/tyler package: own SQLite store, real dependency-free markdown-to-HTML converter (headers/bold/italic/code/rules/fences/tables/checklists -- unit tested against real TYLER syntax including an XSS-escaping test), IDUNA-style-guide-themed Renderer (cream/gold/serif, not the blog's dark theme) with a speechSynthesis 'Listen' audio button. tyler.write permission (migration 202608050002... 202608060001) granted to EMILY-PRIME. Deployed live, verified via curl publish + reading the actual rendered HTML on disk. All 5 existing Series X interludes (x00-x04) published: okemily.com/tyler/.
